title: One helper for instances/<host>/ paths (Highlander)
body: The instances/<host>/... path is built by hand in lib/agent.sh:231, lib/molt.sh:345 and :943, liberators/desktop.sh:44, liberators/ssh.sh:33 and liberators/keys.sh:89 (grep for instances/ to be sure the list is whole). Add one helper in lib/molt.sh, eg molt_instance_file <relative path>, that resolves the user repo and this host and prints the path, failing with a reason when either cannot be found; move every caller onto it. No behaviour change; the suite passes under both bashes.
